verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly support incremental adoption: you can add React to an existing HTML page, render components anywhere, and use as many separate roots as needed for "sprinkles" of React. You can also scale up to fully React-owned routes and entire apps via frameworks like Next.js or React Router, and the GitHub README states you can use as little or as much React as you need. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the incremental-adoption path.
